**Coaching note (80 words):**
When your knight moves, scan what it attacks—here Nxe6 forks the rook and queen! Even though your knight gets taken, after fxe6 the undefended bishop on d3 falls to your queen. You win the exchange (rook for knight) plus the bishop—a decisive advantage. **Lesson: Look for knight moves that attack multiple pieces, especially when the opponent is forced to respond. Often a forcing sequence wins material you didn't see at first glance.**
